heroHeadline: Zaporizhstal Steel Plant Struck for 4th Time in a Month as Ukraine Launches 350+ Drones at Moscow
heroSubtitle: Russia struck the Zaporizhstal steel plant with two ballistic missiles on September 17 — its fourth strike on the idled facility in a little over a month — injuring one worker, while a separate overnight barrage killed 2 and injured 2 at an industrial park in Korosten, Zhytomyr Oblast. Ukraine responded overnight into September 18 with a barrage of more than 350 drones toward the Moscow region, one of the largest such attacks in years, with Moscow's mayor reporting 64 intercepted on approach. On September 18, a Russian drone dropped explosives on hospital grounds in Kherson's Korabelny district, and Russian forces struck the same district of Sloviansk twice within an hour, injuring 5. Russian military losses reached ~1,514,910 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff, an increase of ~1,420 in the latest 24 hours.
